title: Semana Santa as a tourist
text:
Sevilla during Semana Santa is like no other! Do your research ahead of time to understand the culture and crowd, be prepared to just go with the flow.

Most hotels will have the map with times for you to go and scout out places to see the processions- for us it was a little hard to navigate so it wasn’t super helpful. There is an app “El Penitente” that shows you routes, and times of the processions with a gps of where they are (only in Spanish). You can also visit the tourist center next to the Alcazar that will provide you a map and recommendations of where to see them as well.

title: Great Holy Week Guide
text:
Moises gave my family and I a great tour of Seville. We started in the Pilates palace and learned a lot about the history of Seville.

The highlight of the day was watching one of the Seville Holy Week parades. It’s not easy to know where to go to watch them without a ticket and without getting blocked by the crowds when you want to leave. But Moises knew exactly to manage.

I highly recommend this tour, especially if you care fortunate enough to get Moises as your guide.
author: R8644FImikes

title: Historic beautiful Sevilla
text: This was our third visit to Sevilla and finally during Holy Week. The city is flooded with tourists and the historic district is virtually blocked for the whole week. Every day there are at least 5 processions that leave from the various parishes and arrive at the cathedral and then return. The thousands of people invading the city force the creation of one-way pedestrians and police-regulated crossings. Mild climate, great food, friendly people. Go and lose yourself in the tiny streets of Juderia. Historical, religious, beautiful Sevilla.
author: Emiliano1T

title: We learned that the tour...
text: We learned that the tour schedule is subject to change based on a guide’s availability and certain monuments’ modified schedules during the Holy Week. In our case the tour was postponed from 10:30 to about 12:10. Fortunately we had some flexibility that day in our planned itinerary, and it worked out after the guide adjusted the plan.
